subject: Calling R arima inside a Java project

messages.author: 76915546e75a2dd2
messages.subject: Calling R arima inside a Java project
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using Renjin as a library in a Java project.

The code loads a script and evaluates a R function containing a call to arima.

The eval method returns the following error:

The R script threw an error: object 'C_TSconv' not found

The script contains a call to R forecast as well so the maven dependencies are:

  <dependency>
    <groupId>org.renjin</groupId>
    <artifactId>renjin-script-engine</artifactId>
    <version>0.8.2425</version>
  </dependency> 
    <dependency>
    <groupId>org.renjin.cran</groupId>
    <artifactId>forecast</artifactId>
    <version>8.1-b10</version>
  </dependency>

What am I doing wrong? Are there any dependencies missing?


Regards

Mario

messages.subject: Re: Calling R arima inside a Java project
parts:
Hi Mario,

This was related to some problems with Renjin's version of the "stats" package. As our C-to-JVM compiler improves, we've been slowly integrating the C routines from the GNU R stats package, but it's a bit half finished at the moment.

I've integrated a number of time-series related routines for release 0.8.2427 and more of the forecast package tests are passing, but not all:
http://packages.renjin.org/package/org.renjin.cran/forecast/8.1/build/11

Best,
Alex
